date.as_written: vānanandaparvvatavarṣe(!) cāgrahāminikhau vihite ca | dvādaśī lalita mecakapakṣe ... nepāla samvat 795 agrahaṇa vadi dvādaśī ādityavāra

notes: The catalogue lists king Jagajjyoti Malla, but he is not mentioned in the colophon text (and ruled much earlier, NS 734–757). 'sadanantaḥ' in the chronogram verse ('pūrṇṇatāṃ samanayet sadanantaḥ') may be a scribe's name (Sadananta / Ananta) or an epithet/invocation.
